# The agent CLIs CI installs for the live handshakes, pinned (ov-410).
#
# One package@version per line; `#` starts a comment. ci.yml installs exactly
# these. agent-clis-latest.yml installs each package's @latest instead, once a
# day, and opens an issue when that fails, so a new upstream release is
# announced in its own run rather than turning main red.
#
# Why pinned: on Oct 7 npm published @openai/codex 0.161.0 at 16:04 UTC and
# its linux-x64 binary at 16:16. CI installed in between, got the launcher
# without the binary, and the handshake failed on every commit until the
# binary landed. A pinned version is one whose binaries are all published.
#
# To move a pin: wait for the scheduled run to go green on the new version (or
# run it by hand), then change the line here.
opencode-ai@1.18.35
@anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.292
@openai/codex@0.161.0
